parsed.answer: The only relevant evidence describes the opposite causal direction: in adipocytes, nicotine-driven AMPKα2 activation degrades MKP1, causing aberrant p38 MAPK activation that inhibits insulin signaling and thereby increases lipolysis, not the reverse. No evidence supports reduced lipolysis raising p38 phosphorylation in adipose tissue; the cited aging/p38 islet study concerns neither lipolysis nor adipose tissue.
